Company Description

Gravity Interactive, Inc., established in California in 2003, is a leader in the online gaming industry, providing Gravity games to gamers across North America and beyond. It is the wholly owned subsidiary of Gravity Co., Ltd., a company headquartered in Seoul, South Korea. Gravity Co., Ltd. is globally renowned for developing the popular MMORPG title, Ragnarok Online, which has captivated players worldwide. With a mission to deliver exceptional gaming experiences, Gravity Interactive continues to serve a diverse and international audience.


Role Description

This is a month-to-month contract role for a Portuguese and English Bilingual LQA Specialist, for the project we estimate to last approximately 6 months. The role involves conducting linguistic quality assurance (LQA) tests for gaming content, identifying and rectifying translation errors, and ensuring linguistic accuracy and cultural relevance in Portuguese and English, ensuring consistency in the use of terminology across game mechanics, in-game items, storyline elements, and related materials. This position will assess text placement within the user interface and make linguistic adjustments where necessary to accommodate language expansion or contraction. The specialist will collaborate with the QA team and other departments when relevant, offering linguistic or localization support to facilitate overall project quality.


Qualifications

  • Be able to translate minimum of 2000 words/day and/or to review/edit 5000 words/day
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English, with strong command of written and verbal communication in both languages
  • Experience in Linguistic Quality Assurance (LQA) testing or localization, with the ability to identify and address linguistic, cultural, and contextual inaccuracies
  • Knowledge of the gaming industry, familiarity with MMORPGs, and a passion for video games
  • Strong detail-oriented mindset, problem-solving abilities, and capacity to meet deadlines in a hybrid work environment
  • Proficiency in translation and localization tools; basic technical aptitude is a plus
  • Bachelor's degree in Linguistics, Translation, Localization, or a related field preferred
  • Prior experience working in a multicultural environment is advantageous

title: AI Benchmark Engineer (Planning/Operations) - 75063
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Benchmark Engineer (Planning/Operations) - 75063 em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

We are looking for AI Benchmark Engineers specializing in planning and operations to design and build complex, multi-agent benchmark tasks that simulate real-world planning, scheduling, and operational decision-making scenarios. This role focuses on creating constraint-rich problems that evaluate multi-agent reasoning, decomposition, and optimization capabilities in realistic environments.


What does day-to-day life look like?

Design and develop multi-agent benchmark tasks involving:

  • Planning, scheduling, and resource allocation
  • Operational decision-making (project management, logistics, incident response, capacity planning)
  • Create constraint-rich problem statements with multiple interacting variables

Develop verification scripts to evaluate:

  • Feasibility (all constraints satisfied)
  • Completeness (all requirements addressed)
  • Optimality (efficient solutions)

Build decomposition strategies:

  • Split tasks across specialized sub-agents (resource-based, constraint-based, conflict resolution, optimization)
  • Model real-world operational scenarios with dependencies, timelines, and resource constraints
  • Collaborate on improving task quality, coverage, and evaluation rigor


Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in operations, project management, logistics, or supply chain
  • Strong ability to formalize constraints, dependencies, and scheduling logic
  • Proficiency in Python for building verification and validation scripts
  • Strong structured problem-solving and decomposition skills
  • Clear and precise technical writing skills
  • Experience with AI coding benchmarks (e.g., SWE-bench, Terminal-bench)
  • Hands-on experience with Docker (Dockerfiles, image builds, debugging)


Nice to have:

  • Experience with optimization techniques (linear programming, constraint satisfaction, scheduling algorithms)
  • Background in operations research
  • Experience with simulation or modeling tools
  • Knowledge of AI planning systems or automated reasoning
  • Project management experience or certifications (PMP, Agile, etc.)


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of Contract: 4 weeks (adjustable based on engagement)
  • Location :


Evaluation Process:

  • Take home assessment


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Regional Study Director, LATAM
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Regional Study Director, LATAM em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Crinetics is a pharmaceutical company headquartered in San Diego, California, with a growing presence in Latin America, including an office in Brazil. We are developing much-needed therapies for people with endocrine diseases and endocrine-related tumors. We were founded by a dedicated team of scientists with the simple belief that better therapies developed from rigorous innovation can lead to better lives. Our work continues to make a real difference in the lives of patients. We have a prolific discovery engine and a robust preclinical and clinical development pipeline. We are driven by science with a patient-centric and team-oriented culture. Crinetics is known for its inclusive workplace culture. This is an exciting time to join Crinetics as we expand our operations in Latin America and shape our organization into the world’s premier fully integrated endocrine company from discovery to patients. Join our team as we transform the lives of others.


Position Summary:

Please note, the candidate for this role will need to be located in Brazil.

The Regional Study Director, LATAM is responsible for managing the execution of clinical studies and data collection within the LATAM region. The incumbent will serve as a regional clinical study lead who oversees the review, monitoring, and adherence to clinical protocols, as well as managing and building relationships with clinical sites in LATAM. The Regional Study Director, LATAM may oversee other regional study leads within the region to facilitate a streamlined and quality study execution. This role will also work internally and externally with members of the cross-functional study team.


Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities:

These may include but are not limited to:

  • Provide oversight of clinical research studies for LATAM.
  • Manage and build relationships with clinical research sites in LATAM.
  • May oversee the work of other regional study leads within LATAM.
  • Provide operational and strategic input into study documents such as synopsis, protocol, ICF, CRFs, CRF Completion Guidelines, Study Execution Plans, Clinical Data Review Plan, Clinical Database edit specifications, Clinical Study Report (CSR) development, etc.
  • Oversight of all regional vendors and activities including CROs.
  • Oversee regional start up activities including site selection, enrollment projections and activities driving site activation.
  • Develop region specific the subject recruitment/retention strategy and related initiatives.
  • Oversight of regional TMF ongoing quality review, and final reconciliation of study documents including review of site regulatory documents/packages and obtaining of appropriate site insurance, and/or supervision of team members performing these activities.
  • Development of training materials for study team, investigational sites, and vendors.
  • Proactive management of information sharing with key stakeholders using standardized reports and other mechanisms.
  • Assure clinical studies are compliant with GDPR, ICH/GCP and other regulations as appropriate.
  • Outline regional activation hurdles for team.
  • Participate in RFP development and prepare bid templates to facilitate selection of the CROs/vendors, and/or collaboration/supervision with team members performing these activities.
  • Collaborate with counsel to negotiate and draft research contracts and agreements with CROs/vendors and clinical study sites, as needed.
  • Acts as liaison with Regulatory Affairs to assure adherence to GDPR, GCPs; maintenance of SOPs; and assure site and CRO/vendor audits are completed.
  • Perform regional risk management and implement mitigations.
  • Identify potential study issues and recommend and implement solutions or corrective actions as needed.
  • Create realistic plans that clearly define goals, milestones, responsibilities, and results.
  • Maintain focus on strategic objectives while accomplishing operational goals.
  • Make timely, data-driven decisions.
  • Manage daily activities, assign tasks, goals, and development of direct reports.
  • Other duties as assigned.


Required Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in scientific discipline. An equivalent combination of relevant education and applicable job experience may be considered.
  • 12 years of prior clinical operations experience preferably with CRO/small biotech experience and approximately 8 years of experience in a supervisory role.
  • Must be able to travel 25-50% of time, may be higher in accordance with project requirements.
  • Computer skills should include proficiency with Microsoft Office suite of software, electronic TMF systems, IXRS and EDC systems.
  • Excellent understanding of drug development process.
  • Experience in clinical trial supply management.
  • Able to make appropriate decisions to move the project(s) forward.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • Data flow from sites to data processing, review, and resolution.
  • Analysis and report generation.
  • Knowledge of local regulatory requirements.
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks to meet deadlines in a dynamic environment is essential.
  • Study initiation procedures.
  • Ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action


Travel:

You may be required to travel for up to 25-50% of your time.

title: Back End Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Back End Developer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Role

StaffingAbroad is seeking a Senior Backend Engineer/ Senior Software Engineer to join a #1 US-based FinTech & Crypto company . This role is ideal for a highly skilled backend developer who excels in C#/.NET and has a strong focus on writing maintainable, scalable, and secure code . You will play a key role in shaping architecture, ensuring system performance, and embedding best practices while working in a fast-paced and innovative environment.

This is a 100% remote, full-time role Salary $5.000USD to $6.000 USD

English C1 required


What You Will Do

  • Develop and Maintain Applications : Build, enhance, and maintain secure, scalable backend services using C#/.NET and integrate with APIs like Plaid, Dwolla, and Treasury Prime.
  • Shape System Architecture : Contribute to system design, ensuring performance, scalability, and security across FinTech applications.
  • Write Quality Code : Implement and test maintainable, well-documented code, with a focus on automation and software best practices.
  • Support Production Systems : Monitor and troubleshoot production applications to ensure high availability and quick issue resolution.
  • Collaborate Across Teams : Work closely with front-end, QA, product, and IT teams, while mentoring junior engineers.
  • Focus on Security and Compliance : Embed security best practices and maintain compliance with FinTech regulations.


What You Will Need

  • Strong Technical Expertise :
  • Solid foundation in design patterns, software development best practices, and principles like SOLID and Clean Code.
  • Proficiency in C#/.NET, ASP.NET MVC/WebAPI, and Object-Relational Mappers (ORMs).
  • Strong understanding of MSSQL database design and optimization.
  • Familiarity with asynchronous microservices architecture and distributed systems.
  • Experience with modern front-end and server-side technologies such as Node.js and React.
  • Commitment to Software Quality :
  • Hands-on experience with unit testing, mocking, integration testing, and ensuring code coverage.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, particularly in Azure DevOps.
  • Proficient in version control systems, especially Git.
  • Experience and Education :
  • 6+ years of back-end software development experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field (preferred).
  • Collaboration and Communication :
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with team members and stakeholders.
  • Enthusiasm for contributing to a collaborative, dynamic team environment.
  • Cultural Fit :
  • Passion for innovation, accountability, and teamwork.
  • Alignment with a culture that prioritizes excellence in FinTech and Crypto solutions.


Plusses Include

  • Experience with iDesign architecture methodology .
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Azure, including their tools and services.

title: Consultor SAP CO
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Consultor SAP CO em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

O que procuramos?

Estamos em busca de um Consultor SAP CO Sênior com perfil estratégico e resiliente para atuar em um dos projetos mais desafiadores do mercado atual: a transição de um ambiente ECC altamente customizado para um template global em S/4HANA. O perfil ideal deve possuir vasta experiência em projetos de Rollout, com habilidade técnica para navegar em um landscape global complexo e sensibilidade de negócio para atuar na gestão de mudanças. Buscamos um profissional que saiba equilibrar as diretrizes de um template global com as necessidades críticas da localização Brasil, incluindo os impactos da reforma tributária, e que tenha autoridade técnica para guiar o cliente na jornada de volta ao padrão (Standard), reduzindo a dependência de customizações legadas.


Atribuições principais:

· Liderar o processo de implementação e adaptação do módulo CO dentro do Rollout S/4HANA, garantindo o alinhamento com o template global.

· Realizar o mapeamento de processos \"As-Is\" (ECC altamente customizado) e \"To-Be\" (S/4HANA Global Template), identificando gaps e propondo soluções.

· Configurar e suportar os sub-módulos de CO (Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Internal Orders, Product Costing e Profitability Analysis). ·

Atuar diretamente na localização Brasil, garantindo que as exigências fiscais e a nova reforma tributária sejam contempladas na arquitetura global.

· Colaborar com times globais em reuniões técnicas e de negócio, utilizando o inglês de forma fluente para apresentações e documentações.

· Validar e realizar testes integrados, além de suportar a fase de Go-live e Hypercare.

· Capacitar os usuários finais (Key Users) nas novas funcionalidades e processos do S/4HANA.


Requisitos:

· Sólida experiência como Consultor SAP CO (nível Sênior).

· Experiência comprovada em projetos de Rollout de S/4HANA.

· Domínio completo dos processos de Controladoria (CO-PC, CO-PA, CO-OM e Material Ledger).

· Conhecimento profundo em Localização Brasil (Tax e Requirements).

· Vivência em ambientes com landscape complexo e integrações globais.

· Capacidade de negociação técnica para lidar com a resistência à descontinuação de customizações (Z's).

· Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis e de implementação SAP (Activate).


Diferenciais:

· Certificação oficial SAP S/4HANA.

· Conhecimento prático ou estudos avançados sobre os impactos da Reforma Tributária brasileira no SAP.

· Experiência prévia em projetos de transição ECC para S/4HANA (Brownfield ou Greenfield).

· Noções de integração com o módulo FI (FICO) e conhecimento técnico básico (Debugging/ABAP) para análise de legados.


Localidade da posição:

Belo Horizonte - MG


Formato de atuação:

Viagens mensais para MG

title: Senior C#/.NET Full-Stack DBA + Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior C#/.NET Full-Stack DBA + Developer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This position requires fluent English - do not apply with a non-English profile/resume as it will be automatically filtered.


Position Overview  


We are seeking a Senior C#/.NET Developer with deep database ownership experience  to join our growing engineering team. This role is intentionally hybrid: you will design and build software  while also owning the reliability, performance, scalability, and cost management of our SQL databases . 


This position is ideal for a senior engineer who is database-centric but not database-only —someone who enjoys writing production code, building features that interact heavily with data, and taking responsibility for how the database performs in real-world, high-availability environments. 


You will work across application code, database architecture, and Azure infrastructure, partnering closely with product and engineering leadership to deliver scalable, reliable systems. 


Key Responsibilities  


Database Architecture, Performance & Ownership  

  • Design, evolve, and optimize database schemas, indexes, queries, and stored procedures  to support high-performance application workloads 
  • Own database performance tuning , query optimization, and capacity planning across environments 
  • Manage availability, backup/restore, disaster recovery, and survivability  strategies in Azure SQL 
  • Monitor and proactively address performance bottlenecks, deadlocks, blocking, and resource contention  
  • Own database cost management  in Azure, including sizing, scaling strategies, and cost optimization 
  • Ensure data integrity, security, and operational excellence  throughout the application lifecycle 


Software Development & Feature Delivery  

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications and services  using C# and .NET 
  • Build application features that interact deeply with the database , balancing correctness, performance, and maintainability 
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs  and backend services that integrate with internal and third-party systems 
  • Participate in architectural discussions  and influence technical direction across the stack 
  • Perform code reviews  and mentor team members on best practices in both application and database development 
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across application, database, and infrastructure layers 


Azure Cloud & DevOps  

  • Design and operate solutions using Microsoft Azure , with a focus on reliability and observability 
  • Support CI/CD pipelines  and deployment practices using Azure DevOps 
  • Work with monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and rapid issue resolution 
  • Collaborate on infrastructure decisions that impact scalability, performance, and cost 


Required Qualifications  


Experience & Education  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience 
  • 7+ years  of professional experience in C#/.NET software development 
  • Strong written and spoken English (C1 or C2 proficiency) 


Technical Skills (Priority Order)  

  • Strong SQL Server / Azure SQL expertise , including: 

Advanced T-SQL 

Stored procedures and query optimization 

Indexing strategies and execution plan analysis 

Performance tuning and troubleshooting 

  • Proven experience owning database operations , including: 

Backup, restore, high availability, and disaster recovery 

Performance monitoring and scaling 

  • Cost and capacity management in Azure 
  • Expert-level proficiency in C#, .NET Core, and .NET Framework  
  • Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs  
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure services , including App Services, Functions, and Storage
  • Front-end experience with Angular (7–17)  
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum  development methodologies 
  • Proficiency with Git and Azure DevOps  

Soft Skills  

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities 
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of critical systems 
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality and reliability 
  • Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional, distributed teams 

Bonus Points  

  • Microsoft Azure certifications (Developer Associate, Solutions Architect, or similar) 
  • Experience with Plivo or Twilio  
  • Experience with message-based systems  (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, etc.) 
  • Strong understanding of DevOps practices  and production operations 
  • Experience working in HIPAA-regulated environments  
  • Prior team lead experience

What We Offer  

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience 
  • Opportunity to own critical systems  and influence architectural decisions 
  • A collaborative engineering culture that values quality, accountability, and continuous improvement

title: Finance Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Finance Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Finance Manager

Location: Fully Remote (LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time


Strong financial operations don’t just track performance, they drive it. We’re looking for a Finance Manager who can take ownership of our accounting and financial processes, improve reporting speed and accuracy, and support operational decision-making as we scale.


About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, performance-driven consumer brand built for pet owners. We operate across ecommerce and retail, and our finance function plays a critical role in enabling smart, data-driven growth.

We believe finance should be proactive, structured, and tightly connected to operations. That’s where you come in.


The Role

This is an ownership role. You will manage the full accounting cycle, oversee financial reporting, and ensure accuracy across all financial operations.

You will work closely with the VP of Operations and play a key role in improving processes, shortening close cycles, and building a scalable finance function.

This is not a purely back-office role, you’ll be expected to think analytically, identify inefficiencies, and actively improve how we operate.


This Role Is For You If:

  • You think in systems and processes, not just tasks
  • You are detail-oriented and highly organized
  • You are comfortable owning the full accounting cycle
  • You enjoy improving workflows and increasing efficiency
  • You can balance accuracy with speed in a fast-paced environment


This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You prefer narrowly defined tasks without ownership
  • You struggle with deadlines or process improvement
  • You are not comfortable working in a high-growth environment


What You'll Do

Accounting & Financial Operations

  • Own the full accounting cycle, including month-end close
  • Prepare financial statements and reports
  • Ensure accuracy and compliance across financial records

Month-End Close & Process Improvement

  • Reduce month-end close timeline from 5 days to 3 days
  • Identify inefficiencies and improve accounting workflows
  • Build scalable processes and documentation

Team Oversight

  • Manage and oversee the bookkeeping team and AP clerk
  • Ensure quality, accuracy, and timeliness of work

Cost & Inventory Accounting

  • Manage and apply landed costs across products
  • Ensure accurate cost tracking and margin visibility

Reporting & Analysis

  • Provide financial insights and analysis to support decision-making
  • Work closely with the VP of Operations on performance tracking


Requirements

Must have:

  • 1+ year of experience in ecommerce or DTC
  • Experience managing full accounting cycle and financial reporting
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • High attention to detail and organization

Work Requirements

⏰ Schedule: Flexble

Workspace: Fixed, professional setup required (stable internet + backup plan)


Benefits & Compensation

  • Fully remote
  • Paid time off
  • Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire
  • Ownership & autonomy - trusted to build and execute strategy


Ready to Apply?

If you want to build and scale a high-performing finance function, apply now.

  • Manter o CRM atualizado com status do lead, próximos passos, gravações e insights de cada conversa
  • Bater meta mensal de receita
  • Reportar os feedbacks e objeções recorrentes dos leads para alimentar marketing e produto
  • Acompanhar as suas métricas de desempenho e buscar evolução contínua


Competências

  • Experiência prévia comprovada como Closer ou em vendas consultivas de ticket alto (a partir de R$ 3.000)
  • Domínio de técnicas de fechamento consultivo (SPIN Selling, quebra de objeções, ancoragem de valor, criação de urgência ética)
  • Excelente comunicação verbal (calls) e escrita (follow-ups por WhatsApp e e-mail)
  • Inteligência emocional e resiliência para lidar com objeções e \"nãos\" sem desgaste
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com metas claras e ciclo de venda mais longo
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de CRM e gestão de pipeline
  • Postura consultiva — você ouve antes de falar, entende antes de oferecer
  • Diferencial: conhecimento ou interesse pelo mercado de nutrição ou educação.

- Excelência na entrega

- Foco na necessidade dos clientes

- Transparência

O Mercado Eletrônico é líder na América Latina em soluções de gestão de compras B2B. Suas tecnologias e serviços para as áreas de compras ajudam empresas a conquistarem mais economia, agilidade, governança e colaboração.

Com escritórios no Brasil, Estados Unidos, México e Portugal, contabiliza mais de 1 milhão de fornecedores, 10 mil compradores e transaciona um valor acima de R$ 160 bilhões em negócios anualmente. Product Owner Sr

contratação CLT


Estamos em busca de um Product Owner (PO), responsável por liderar o desenvolvimento de soluções que otimizem as jornadas de compras no ecossistema B2B, alinhando objetivos de negócio às necessidades dos clientes.


Quais serão suas responsabilidades neste desafio?

  • Gerenciar o backlog de produto, priorizando demandas com base no impacto para o negócio e nos objetivos estratégicos da empresa.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares (design, engenharia, negócios) para garantir a entrega de soluções inovadoras e de alta qualidade.
  • Definir histórias de usuário e critérios de aceitação com base nas necessidades dos stakeholders.
  • Analisar e mapear processos de compras para propor melhorias que agreguem valor aos nossos clientes.
  • Atuar como referência interna em processos de compras, com conhecimentos complementares em tributação e finanças, garantindo que as soluções atendam às normas e regulamentações aplicáveis.
  • Monitorar KPIs e avaliar a performance das soluções implementadas.


Será bacana se você tiver:

  • Experiência comprovada como Product Owner ou em posições semelhantes.
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em processos de compras corporativas será considerado um diferencial;
  • Bons conhecimentos em Inteligência Artificial (IA) , com experiência em diversas LLMs e engenharia de prompt.
  • Habilidade em criar e gerenciar roadmaps de produto.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Experiência com plataformas de e-procurement ou marketplace B2B é um diferencial.
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara e eficaz com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Perfil analítico e orientado a resultados.


Diferenciais:

  • Certificações em Agile (CSPO, SAFe) ou Product Management.
  • Experiência prévia em empresas de tecnologia ou consultoria em processos de compras e/ou finanças.

title: Engenheiro de Software Sênior (Tribo IA)
description:

No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.

  • Experiência prática ou acadêmica em Generative AI, NLP, Large Language Models (LLMs) ou Machine Learning.

  • Experiência ou familiaridade com Prompt Engineering, avaliação de modelos e experimentação com LLMs.
  • Conhecimento em integração de APIs e desenvolvimento de aplicações que utilizem modelos de IA.
  • Capacidade de desenvolver provas de conceito (POCs), protótipos e soluções experimentais para validação técnica.
  • Interesse por pesquisa aplicada, experimentação tecnológica e exploração de novas abordagens em IA.

  • Experiência na integração de LLMs com aplicações, APIs e fluxos de dados.
  • Conhecimento em Machine Learning aplicado, incluindo avaliação de modelos, métricas, benchmarks e conceitos de Responsible AI.

  • Experiência ou interesse em agentes de IA, automações e uso avançado de ferramentas de inteligência artificial.

description:

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Estamos buscando um líder técnico que vai auxiliar o time de Engenharia de IA a:


-> Inteligência Artificial e IA Generativa

  • Desenvolver e implementar sistemas multi-agente utilizando AWS Bedrock e LLMs;
  • Construir agentes conversacionais especializados;
  • Implementar soluções de IA generativa;
  • Realizar prompt engineering e otimização de modelos de linguagem.


-> Machine Learning e Ciência de Dados

  • Analisar grandes volumes de dados para identificar padrões e insights de negócio;
  • Construir modelos preditivos e algoritmos de machine learning;
  • Desenvolver pipelines de dados automatizados para coleta e processamento;
  • Criar visualizações e dashboards para comunicar resultados.


-> Engenharia e Produção

  • Implementar pipelines de CI/CD para modelos e aplicações de IA;
  • Monitorar performance de modelos em produção;
  • Colaborar com equipes de engenharia para integrar soluções de IA/ML;
  • Desenvolver testes automatizados e frameworks de avaliação.

Essenciais:

  • Ensino superior completo ou em andamento;
  • Experiência mínima de 2 anos com IA, ML ou Ciência de Dados;

  • Experiência com bibliotecas de ML/DS: Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn;
  • Conhecimento em AWS (Bedrock, Lambda, S3);
  • Git e desenvolvimento colaborativo;
  • Experiência em liderança de times de IA.

Competências:

  • Capacidade analítica e resolução de problemas;
  • Comunicação clara de conceitos técnicos;
  • Autonomia e proatividade;
  • Trabalho colaborativo em equipes ágeis.

Estamos em busca de um Product Owner (PO), responsável por liderar o desenvolvimento de soluções que otimizem as jornadas de compras no ecossistema B2B, alinhando objetivos de negócio às necessidades dos clientes.

title: Senior GCP QA Auditor
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior GCP QA Auditor em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior GCP QA Auditor – Full Time – Permanent – Remote – South America

At Zigzag, you will become a pivotal member of our team, working alongside industry leading experts and delivering our client’s quality assurance aspirations and outcomes.


**Please submit your CV in English**


What we are looking for

  • Extensive auditing experience in GCP. Thorough knowledge of GCP.
  • Additional knowledge of another GxP areas (GLP, GCLP, GMP, CSV, PV) would be advantageous.
  • Able to confidently audit Investigator Sites with limited oversight.
  • Life science degree.
  • Strong client focus.


What Zigzag has to offer you

  • Leading Quality Assurance consultancy company – Our auditors work internationally across different types of organizations and audits and other QA related projects, with top thought-leaders in the industry. We are committed to continuous professional development.
  • Fostering Success in our Auditors - Scheduling to ensure you are able to deliver your best, every time.
  • A Truly Supportive and Management Team – Having a supportive and open leadership team allows our people to show up and be their best.
  • WiZe working schedule - Flexible working schedule to allow you to live your life around work.
  • A Competitive Compensation Package – We believe our people need to be compensated for their dedication.
  • Sustainability – We endeavour to keep auditors travel as local as possible to reduce our carbon footprint in line with our sustainability policy as well as ensuring you have a work/life balance.


What You’ll Do With Us

Auditors target will be to work to 70% utilisation, which could require up to 50% travel to client sites, that doesn’t mean you’ll be away from home for months at a time, as we ensure we schedule assignments for a fair work/life balance.


Our auditors are deployed to audit Investigator Sites and Vendors, as well as eTMF audits which are done remotely.


You’ll support our clients with Inspection Readiness and Inspection Management related activities across a diverse range of roles and regulatory bodies.


Who We Are

ZigZagQA is a trusted global leader in QA management, offering true global reach and unrivalled expertise to reduce risk and efforts. Working as an extension of our clients team, our experts increase capability and efficiency with collaborative, comprehensive and customized QA programs.


We partners with a wide range of clients across the entire drug discovery and development process to improve GxP Quality against global regulatory standards. We work with top 20 Pharmaceutical and Biotechnology companies, all the way to startups.


We strive for excellence, aiming to be the number one choice for our clients and our employees. We are passionate about Continuous Improvement and are always looking for a ‘better way’.

We are a global, quality leader who put people first and forge lasting relationships to bring deep impact in the industry.

title: Senior AI Software Engineer (LLM & Agent Systems)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior AI Software Engineer (LLM & Agent Systems) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Overview

Our client is a fast-growing technology company building modern, data-driven products with a strong focus on leveraging AI to create scalable systems and internal efficiencies. Their team is focused on moving fast, shipping high-quality solutions, and using the latest advancements in AI to multiply engineering output across the organization.


They are particularly focused on applying AI not as a feature, but as a core layer of how work gets done —automating workflows, enhancing product capabilities, and enabling small teams to achieve outsized impact.


Role Overview

We are looking for a full-time (40 hours/week) Senior AI Systems Engineer who operates natively with AI tools and builds production-ready systems using agents and LLM workflows.

This role requires someone who has gone beyond basic AI usage and can design and deploy systems that automate work, integrate tools, and significantly increase engineering productivity .

You will work in the EST time zone , collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to identify opportunities where AI can replace manual processes and unlock efficiency.


Key Responsibilities

  • Build and deploy AI agents for internal and user-facing workflows
  • Design systems that retrieve, process, and act on data autonomously
  • Integrate APIs, tools, and data sources into AI-driven workflows
  • Use tools like Claude/Codex to accelerate development and output
  • Identify and implement AI-driven automation opportunities across teams
  • Continuously experiment with new AI capabilities and approaches


Requirements

  • Proven experience building AI agents or LLM-powered systems
  • Deep, hands-on usage of Claude, Codex, or similar tools
  • Strong backend or full-stack engineering experience (Python, JavaScript, Ruby, Go, Elixir, etc.)
  • Ability to independently ship complex systems
  • Experience integrating APIs and building scalable workflows


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with vector databases (Pinecone, PgVector, etc.)
  • Exposure to data pipelines or data infrastructure
  • Experience building internal automation tools


Key Traits

  • Builder mindset and high ownership
  • Strong focus on productivity and leverage
  • Demonstrated portfolio of AI-driven projects

About Turing:

title: Consultor SAP CO
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Consultor SAP CO em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

O que procuramos?

Estamos em busca de um Consultor SAP CO Sênior com perfil estratégico e resiliente para atuar em um dos projetos mais desafiadores do mercado atual: a transição de um ambiente ECC altamente customizado para um template global em S/4HANA. O perfil ideal deve possuir vasta experiência em projetos de Rollout, com habilidade técnica para navegar em um landscape global complexo e sensibilidade de negócio para atuar na gestão de mudanças. Buscamos um profissional que saiba equilibrar as diretrizes de um template global com as necessidades críticas da localização Brasil, incluindo os impactos da reforma tributária, e que tenha autoridade técnica para guiar o cliente na jornada de volta ao padrão (Standard), reduzindo a dependência de customizações legadas.


Atribuições principais:

· Liderar o processo de implementação e adaptação do módulo CO dentro do Rollout S/4HANA, garantindo o alinhamento com o template global.

· Realizar o mapeamento de processos \"As-Is\" (ECC altamente customizado) e \"To-Be\" (S/4HANA Global Template), identificando gaps e propondo soluções.

· Configurar e suportar os sub-módulos de CO (Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Internal Orders, Product Costing e Profitability Analysis). ·

Atuar diretamente na localização Brasil, garantindo que as exigências fiscais e a nova reforma tributária sejam contempladas na arquitetura global.

· Colaborar com times globais em reuniões técnicas e de negócio, utilizando o inglês de forma fluente para apresentações e documentações.

· Validar e realizar testes integrados, além de suportar a fase de Go-live e Hypercare.

· Capacitar os usuários finais (Key Users) nas novas funcionalidades e processos do S/4HANA.


Requisitos:

· Sólida experiência como Consultor SAP CO (nível Sênior).

· Experiência comprovada em projetos de Rollout de S/4HANA.

· Domínio completo dos processos de Controladoria (CO-PC, CO-PA, CO-OM e Material Ledger).

· Conhecimento profundo em Localização Brasil (Tax e Requirements).

· Vivência em ambientes com landscape complexo e integrações globais.

· Capacidade de negociação técnica para lidar com a resistência à descontinuação de customizações (Z's).

· Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis e de implementação SAP (Activate).


Diferenciais:

· Certificação oficial SAP S/4HANA.

· Conhecimento prático ou estudos avançados sobre os impactos da Reforma Tributária brasileira no SAP.

· Experiência prévia em projetos de transição ECC para S/4HANA (Brownfield ou Greenfield).

· Noções de integração com o módulo FI (FICO) e conhecimento técnico básico (Debugging/ABAP) para análise de legados.


Localidade da posição:

Belo Horizonte - MG


Formato de atuação:

Viagens mensais para MG


Idioma:

Inglês - Nível: Avançado


Por que construir sua carreira na Meta?

Oferecemos autonomia, metas claras e um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, onde os profissionais têm oportunidade de interagir com diferentes tecnologias, participar de todos os tipos de projetos, trazer novas ideias e trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil e (por que não?) do mundo. Além disso, somos uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil segundo o Great Place to Work e uma das 10 empresas que mais crescem no país há 3 anos consecutivos, segundo o Anuário Informática Hoje.


Quais são nossos valores?

- Somos pessoas servindo pessoas

- Pensamos e agimos como donos

- Temos gana por performance

- Crescemos e aprendemos juntos

Todas as pessoas são bem-vindas independentemente de sua condição, deficiência, etnia, crença religiosa, orientação sexual, aparência, idade ou afins. Queremos que você cresça conosco em um ambiente acolhedor e repleto de oportunidades.

title: Gerente de Vendas
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Gerente de Vendas em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Estamos em busca de um Gerente de Vendas Sênior com experiência relevante na indústria de componentes eletrônicos para integrar a equipe da Win Source. O candidato ideal será responsável por desenvolver contas, realizar o acompanhamento de consultas e manter relacionamentos de longo prazo. Esta posição é fundamental para aprimorar o desempenho de vendas da empresa e a satisfação do cliente.


Sobre a Win Source:


A Win Source é uma distribuidora líder de componentes eletrônicos, comprometida em oferecer serviços de excelência e soluções inovadoras para clientes em todo o mundo. Nossa missão é apoiar o avanço tecnológico de nossos clientes, garantindo a disponibilidade de componentes de alta qualidade.


Site da empresa: win-source.net


Conteúdo do Trabalho: (Jornada de trabalho de 5 dias, 8 horas diárias)

1. Desenvolver clientes, realizar acompanhamento (follow-up), identificar e classificar consultas de clientes, e executar a manutenção contínua desses contatos.

2. Elaborar cotações para produtos solicitados pelos clientes, acompanhar a demanda dos clientes por produtos, conduzir negociações comerciais, concluir pedidos e monitorar a entrega dos produtos para garantir a qualidade, quantidade, prazo de entrega e modalidade de transporte, conforme os requisitos do cliente.

3. Desenvolver estrategicamente seu território de vendas por meio da aquisição planejada e sistemática de novos clientes, mantendo comunicação e coordenação constantes com os departamentos internos de atendimento e técnico.

4. Manter regularmente um bom serviço de pós-venda e bons relacionamentos com os clientes, via e-mail e telefone, preservando parcerias de cooperação de longo prazo.

5. Motivar e liderar a equipe de vendas, definir objetivos claros, monitorar a evolução do desempenho e fornecer os treinamentos e recursos necessários.

6. Realizar viagens de negócios locais para visitar clientes e participar de diversas feiras e exposições do setor.


Perspectivas de Carreira:

Engenheiro de Vendas Sênior → Líder de Equipe Comercial → Gerente Regional → Diretor de Vendas


Sistema Remuneratório:

Salário base + Comissão + Bônus por Desempenho + Bônus por Projetos + Bônus de Final de Ano


Requisitos para a Vaga:

1. Disponibilidade para atuar em escritórios nacionais em diversas partes do mundo.

Os países com vagas abertas incluem: Estados Unidos, Japão, Reino Unido, Canadá, Alemanha, Itália, Austrália, Dinamarca, Espanha, França, Coreia do Sul, Brasil e Malásia. (É exigido residir e trabalhar localmente, além de possuir planos de desenvolvimento de longo prazo na região).

2. Possuir conhecimento específico sobre componentes eletrônicos ou sobre a indústria eletrônica, compreendendo as tendências de mercado e as necessidades dos clientes.

3. Experiência na indústria de distribuição de componentes eletrônicos é um diferencial.


Benefícios:

1. Desfrutar de feriados nacionais oficiais e benefícios festivos. 2. Os funcionários efetivos terão direito a gratificações por tempo de serviço, férias anuais remuneradas (de até 10 dias) e licença-maternidade remunerada.

3. A empresa organiza viagens anualmente e promove outras atividades periodicamente.

4. Convidamos regularmente profissionais de destaque do setor para treinamentos e aprendizado, além de realizarmos sessões de compartilhamento de experiências de negócios.

5. A empresa participa regularmente de feiras internacionais de eletrônicos todos os anos (nos Estados Unidos, Alemanha, Vietnã e Brasil).

6. Oferecemos treinamento remunerado abrangente, incluindo capacitação inicial sobre produtos, métodos comerciais e raciocínio estratégico, organizado em etapas para garantir uma formação sistemática, com orientação individual personalizada (mentoria 1 a 1).

7. O período de experiência inclui o recebimento de comissões, e há dois dias de folga aos finais de semana.


Requisitos e Habilidades:

1. Graduação (nível superior) ou formação acadêmica superior; a área de formação é flexível (preferência para cursos em Engenharia Eletrônica ou Marketing).

2. Boas habilidades de escuta, fala, leitura e escrita; proficiência no uso do idioma inglês para comunicação e negociação com clientes.

3. Boas habilidades de comunicação, coordenação e execução; capacidade de resposta rápida e perspicaz; forte senso de responsabilidade.

4. Experiência em técnicas e estratégias de vendas, incluindo habilidades de apresentação e negociação.

5. Forte capacidade de aprendizado e espírito de busca por aprendizado contínuo.

6. Aspiração em atuar e paixão pelo setor de comércio exterior e e-commerce.

7. Bom espírito de equipe.

title: Remote Computer Science Expert - 79004
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Computer Science Expert - 79004 em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Job Overview:

We are looking for PhD-level computer science experts to help fine-tune and evaluate large language models, including systems similar to ChatGPT. The role focuses on designing challenging, conceptual computer science problems that test advanced AI reasoning across topics such as algorithms, systems design, cybersecurity, theory, databases, networks, and other undergraduate to PhD-level computer science domains.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design advanced computer science problems that test AI model performance across conceptual and reasoning-heavy topics, including systems design, algorithms, cybersecurity, and other advanced CS areas.
  • Develop clear, step-by-step reference solutions with rigorous logic, well-structured explanations, and defensible reasoning.
  • Evaluate AI-generated responses for correctness, reasoning quality, completeness, clarity, and alignment with the intended problem requirements.
  • Identify flaws, gaps, edge cases, and near-miss reasoning patterns in AI outputs.
  • Collaborate with researchers to refine benchmarks across undergraduate, graduate, and PhD-level computer science topics.
  • Provide structured feedback to improve problem quality, benchmark reliability, and model evaluation standards.


Required Qualifications:

  • PhD, completed or pursuing, in Computer Science or a closely related field.
  • Strong computer science reasoning and problem-solving skills across advanced domains.
  • Ability to design challenging conceptual problems that require deep understanding rather than straightforward recall or coding.
  • Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical ideas clearly and logically.
  • Strong attention to detail in evaluating reasoning, assumptions, definitions, edge cases, and solution validity.
  • Ability to provide structured, high-quality feedback on AI-generated responses.
  • No prior AI experience required.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form.
  • After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours.
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to schedule an interview.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Customer Retention Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Retention Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered text and voice communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. We’re building a best-in-class product with world-class talent to serve customers who rave about us. Will you join us?


About you:

This is a direct-hire role. As a Customer Retention Specialist, your primary responsibility is to reduce churn and protect revenue. You will proactively engage canceled and churned accounts via calls, text, and emails to understand why. Most importantly, you’ll be the bridge that enables customer success, helping us retain them. As a result, retained revenue will follow with subscription renewals, of which you will be responsible for attaining a monthly quota.


What You’ll Own:

  • Responsible for reducing churn by retaining customers and revenue.
  • You’ll own a monthly customer retention quota as your main KPI.
  • Apply approved retention strategies (in-app credits, billing credits, plan downgrades, and success enablement) within defined guidelines.
  • Intercept downgrade requests and reposition value through usage planning, campaign scheduling, and ROI alignment before the plan change is approved.
  • Identify and recover failed onboarding cases by re-driving activation and time-to-first-value.
  • Perform proactive outreach to low-usage and disengaged accounts using structured “silent churn” playbooks to re-engage customers before cancellation intent surfaces.
  • Working with the Success team, diagnose root causes of underperformance (targeting, messaging, timing, setup) and implement corrective actions that directly improve campaign outcomes.

  • Conhecimento de conceitos de governança de dados , metadados, linhagem, rastreabilidade e organização de ativos informacionais.
  • Familiaridade com contextos de migração de dados e modernização de ambientes, preferencialmente de Oracle on-premises para Cloud .
  • Capacidade de traduzir discussões técnicas em documentação clara, estruturada e de fácil consulta.


Diferencial:

  • Experiência com ferramentas de catálogo de dados e/ou iniciativas de catalogação.
  • Atuação prévia em projetos de governança de dados em ambiente cloud .
  • Conhecimento em data lineage , glossário de dados, dicionário de dados e inventário de ativos.

  • Modelo de Atuação: Home Office.

title: Portugues and English Bilingual LQA Freelancer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Portugues and English Bilingual LQA Freelancer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description

Gravity Interactive, Inc., established in California in 2003, is a leader in the online gaming industry, providing Gravity games to gamers across North America and beyond. It is the wholly owned subsidiary of Gravity Co., Ltd., a company headquartered in Seoul, South Korea. Gravity Co., Ltd. is globally renowned for developing the popular MMORPG title, Ragnarok Online, which has captivated players worldwide. With a mission to deliver exceptional gaming experiences, Gravity Interactive continues to serve a diverse and international audience.


Role Description

This is a month-to-month contract role for a Portuguese and English Bilingual LQA Specialist, for the project we estimate to last approximately 6 months. The role involves conducting linguistic quality assurance (LQA) tests for gaming content, identifying and rectifying translation errors, and ensuring linguistic accuracy and cultural relevance in Portuguese and English, ensuring consistency in the use of terminology across game mechanics, in-game items, storyline elements, and related materials. This position will assess text placement within the user interface and make linguistic adjustments where necessary to accommodate language expansion or contraction. The specialist will collaborate with the QA team and other departments when relevant, offering linguistic or localization support to facilitate overall project quality.


Qualifications

  • Be able to translate minimum of 2000 words/day and/or to review/edit 5000 words/day
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English, with strong command of written and verbal communication in both languages
  • Experience in Linguistic Quality Assurance (LQA) testing or localization, with the ability to identify and address linguistic, cultural, and contextual inaccuracies
  • Knowledge of the gaming industry, familiarity with MMORPGs, and a passion for video games
  • Strong detail-oriented mindset, problem-solving abilities, and capacity to meet deadlines in a hybrid work environment
  • Proficiency in translation and localization tools; basic technical aptitude is a plus
  • Bachelor's degree in Linguistics, Translation, Localization, or a related field preferred
  • Prior experience working in a multicultural environment is advantageous

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Benchmark Engineer (Planning/Operations) - 75063 em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

We are looking for AI Benchmark Engineers specializing in planning and operations to design and build complex, multi-agent benchmark tasks that simulate real-world planning, scheduling, and operational decision-making scenarios. This role focuses on creating constraint-rich problems that evaluate multi-agent reasoning, decomposition, and optimization capabilities in realistic environments.


What does day-to-day life look like?

Design and develop multi-agent benchmark tasks involving:

  • Planning, scheduling, and resource allocation
  • Operational decision-making (project management, logistics, incident response, capacity planning)
  • Create constraint-rich problem statements with multiple interacting variables

Develop verification scripts to evaluate:

  • Feasibility (all constraints satisfied)
  • Completeness (all requirements addressed)
  • Optimality (efficient solutions)

Build decomposition strategies:

  • Split tasks across specialized sub-agents (resource-based, constraint-based, conflict resolution, optimization)
  • Model real-world operational scenarios with dependencies, timelines, and resource constraints
  • Collaborate on improving task quality, coverage, and evaluation rigor


Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in operations, project management, logistics, or supply chain
  • Strong ability to formalize constraints, dependencies, and scheduling logic
  • Proficiency in Python for building verification and validation scripts
  • Strong structured problem-solving and decomposition skills
  • Clear and precise technical writing skills
  • Experience with AI coding benchmarks (e.g., SWE-bench, Terminal-bench)
  • Hands-on experience with Docker (Dockerfiles, image builds, debugging)


Nice to have:

  • Experience with optimization techniques (linear programming, constraint satisfaction, scheduling algorithms)
  • Background in operations research
  • Experience with simulation or modeling tools
  • Knowledge of AI planning systems or automated reasoning
  • Project management experience or certifications (PMP, Agile, etc.)


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.

title: AI Benchmark Engineer (Reasoning/Math) - 75046
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Benchmark Engineer (Reasoning/Math) - 75046 em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

We are seeking a highly analytical and computationally proficient individual to join our team with a strong research background. You will be instrumental in contributing to this role by either crafting challenging and insightful problems in your respective research domain, devising elegant computational solutions.


Responsibilities:

  • Build multi-agent benchmark tasks that require multi-step mathematical reasoning, proof construction, or algorithmic problem-solving
  • Design problems that are genuinely hard for a single agent but decomposable — competition math, numerical analysis, combinatorial optimization, statistical inference
  • Create verification scripts that check mathematical correctness — numerical answers with appropriate tolerance, proof step validity, algorithm output correctness
  • Write clear problem statements with precise notation, definitions, and output format
  • Create decomposition guides that split problems into independent sub-computations or parallel solution strategies


Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in mathematics, quantitative research, or computational science (e.g., competition math, university-level mathematics, or quantitative research)
  • Strong Python programming skills, including NumPy, SciPy, or symbolic computation (SymPy)
  • Experience writing mathematical proofs or formal derivations
  • Ability to create problems with precise, verifiable answers (not subjective or open-ended)
  • Familiarity with AI coding benchmarks such as SWE-bench and Terminal-bench
  • Comfortable with Docker (writing Dockerfiles, building images, debugging containers)
  • Understanding of numerical methods, including floating-point tolerance, convergence criteria, and error bounds


Nice to have:

  • Experience creating math competition problems (e.g., AMC, AIME, Putnam, IMO, or similar)
  • Research experience in mathematics, theoretical computer science, or quantitative fields
  • Experience with automated theorem proving or formal verification
  • Knowledge of AI reasoning benchmarks (e.g., GSM8K, MATH, AIME, GPQA, ARC-AGI)
  • Experience with large-scale numerical computation or scientific computing


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments required: 40 hours /week with 4 hours of PST Overlap
  • Engagement type: Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 1 month; (expected start date is next week)


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

description:

A Brunel está apoiando uma empresa referência em soluções de dados e analytics na busca por um(a) Gerente de Projetos de Dados .


Essa pessoa terá um papel estratégico na condução de iniciativas end-to-end — desde a fase de discovery até o go-live — atuando como ponte entre áreas técnicas e de negócio. O desafio envolve liderar projetos complexos de dados, garantindo entregas de alta qualidade, dentro do prazo e alinhadas aos objetivos da organização.


Buscamos um perfil que una forte experiência em gestão de projetos com repertório técnico em dados, capaz de navegar com autonomia entre stakeholders, engenharia e decisões de arquitetura.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Liderar projetos de dados de média e alta complexidade (data warehouse, data lake, ETL/ELT, BI, migração de dados, entre outros).
  • Definir e gerenciar escopo, cronograma, orçamento, recursos e riscos.

  • Impulsionar melhoria contínua nas práticas de gestão de projetos da área de dados.

  • Experiência consolidada (5+ anos) em gestão de projetos de tecnologia, sendo ao menos 2 anos em projetos de dados ou analytics.
  • Conhecimento prático do ecossistema de dados: data warehouse, data lake, ETL/ELT, modelagem de dados e ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Qlik, Tableau ou similares).
  • Domínio de metodologias ágeis e tradicionais (Scrum, Kanban, PMBOK/Waterfall), com flexibilidade de aplicação.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão (Jira, Azure DevOps, Monday, Asana ou similares).
  • Forte habilidade de gestão de stakeholders e comunicação executiva.
  • Capacidade de interpretar documentação técnica (arquitetura, modelos de dados, integrações).
  • Inglês fluente (interação constante com times e stakeholders internacionais).


Diferenciais

  • Background técnico prévio (Data Analyst, Data Engineer ou BI Developer).
  • Experiência com cloud (Azure, AWS ou GCP).
  • Uso de soluções de IA como aceleradores de entrega.
  • Conhecimento em SQL para validações básicas.
  • Vivência com change management em contextos data-driven.
  • Conhecimento em governança de dados (ex: DAMA-DMBOK).
  • Certificações (PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, PSM, SAFe ou similares).
  • Experiência com gestão de portfólio e priorização estratégica.

title: Senior C#/.NET Full-Stack Lead Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior C#/.NET Full-Stack Lead Developer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are seeking a Senior C#/.NET Lead Developer to join our growing engineering team. This role combines hands-on senior development with day-to-day team leadership, working closely with the CTO. You will design and build software while also manage day-to-day engineering operations - including ticket creation and assignment, PR oversight, and team processes.


This position is ideal for a senior engineer who is technically strong and has prior experience in a lead role - someone who enjoys writing production code, mentoring a talented senior team, and helping coordinate the day-to-day workflow so the CTO can focus on higher-level direction.


You will work across application code and Azure infrastructure, partnering closely with the CTO to deliver scalable, reliable systems and keep a high-performing team running smoothly.


Key Responsibilities


Team Leadership & Engineering Operations

• Work closely with the CTO to manage day-to-day engineering workload and ensure the team stays productive and unblocked

• Own ticket creation, triage, and assignment, keeping the backlog healthy and priorities clear

• Oversee pull request processes, ensuring code quality standards are upheld and reviews are timely

• Maintain and improve engineering processes and standards across a predominantly senior team

• Ensure strong database practices are followed across the team, including schema design, query efficiency, and data integrity

• Serve as a technical point of contact for escalations, cross-team coordination, and architectural decisions


Software Development & Feature Delivery

• Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications and services using C# and .NET

• Build application features that interact deeply with the database, balancing correctness, performance, and maintainability

• Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and backend services that integrate with internal and third-party systems

• Participate in architectural discussions and influence technical direction across the stack

• Perform code reviews and mentor team members on best practices in both application and database development

• Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across application, database, and infrastructure layers


Azure Cloud & DevOps

• Design and operate solutions using Microsoft Azure, with a focus on reliability and observability

• Support CI/CD pipelines and deployment practices using Azure DevOps

• Work with monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and rapid issue resolution

• Collaborate on infrastructure decisions that impact scalability, performance, and cost


Required Qualifications


Experience & Education

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience

• 7+ years of professional experience in C#/.NET software development

• Strong written and spoken English (C1 or C2 proficiency)


Technical Skills (Priority Order)

• Expert-level proficiency in C#, .NET Core, and .NET Framework

• Proven experience in a lead or senior lead developer role, assisting engineering management with day-to-day team operations

  • Strong SQL Server / Azure SQL knowledge from a developer perspective
  • Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs

• Experience with Microsoft Azure services, including App Services, Storage, and Azure SQL Database

• Experience integrating with third-party APIs

• CRM system experience and familiarity with common CRM integration patterns

• Front-end experience with Angular (7–17)

• Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development methodologies

• Proficiency with Git and Azure DevOps


Soft Skills

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics to non-technical stakeholders

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities

• Ability to work independently and take ownership of critical systems

• High attention to detail and commitment to quality and reliability

• Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional, distributed teams


Bonus Qualifications

• Experience with communications platforms and APIs such as Twilio, Vonage, Plivo, or similar for SMS, voice, and messaging workflows

• Familiarity with real-time communications protocols: VoIP, WebRTC, and SIP

• Experience with open-source telephony platforms such as Asterisk or FreeSWITCH

• Experience with message-based systems (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, etc.)

• Strong understanding of DevOps practices and production operations

• Experience working in HIPAA-regulated environments


What We Offer

title: Data Project Manager (remote)
description:

A Brunel está apoiando uma empresa referência em soluções de dados e analytics na busca por um(a) Gerente de Projetos de Dados .


Essa pessoa terá um papel estratégico na condução de iniciativas end-to-end — desde a fase de discovery até o go-live — atuando como ponte entre áreas técnicas e de negócio. O desafio envolve liderar projetos complexos de dados, garantindo entregas de alta qualidade, dentro do prazo e alinhadas aos objetivos da organização.


Buscamos um perfil que una forte experiência em gestão de projetos com repertório técnico em dados, capaz de navegar com autonomia entre stakeholders, engenharia e decisões de arquitetura.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Liderar projetos de dados de média e alta complexidade (data warehouse, data lake, ETL/ELT, BI, migração de dados, entre outros).
  • Definir e gerenciar escopo, cronograma, orçamento, recursos e riscos.
  • Conduzir cerimônias ágeis (dailies, sprints, retrospectivas) e adaptar frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, híbrido) conforme o contexto.
  • Atuar como interface entre times técnicos e áreas de negócio, traduzindo demandas em planos de execução claros.
  • Monitorar KPIs de projeto (velocity, burn-down, progresso) e comunicar status para diferentes níveis da organização.
  • Antecipar riscos, dependências e gargalos, propondo planos de mitigação.
  • Gerenciar fornecedores e parceiros envolvidos nas entregas.
  • Garantir documentação estruturada de processos, decisões e aprendizados.
  • Impulsionar melhoria contínua nas práticas de gestão de projetos da área de dados.


Requisitos

  • Experiência consolidada (5+ anos) em gestão de projetos de tecnologia, sendo ao menos 2 anos em projetos de dados ou analytics.
  • Conhecimento prático do ecossistema de dados: data warehouse, data lake, ETL/ELT, modelagem de dados e ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Qlik, Tableau ou similares).
  • Domínio de metodologias ágeis e tradicionais (Scrum, Kanban, PMBOK/Waterfall), com flexibilidade de aplicação.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão (Jira, Azure DevOps, Monday, Asana ou similares).
  • Forte habilidade de gestão de stakeholders e comunicação executiva.
  • Capacidade de interpretar documentação técnica (arquitetura, modelos de dados, integrações).
  • Inglês fluente (interação constante com times e stakeholders internacionais).


Diferenciais

  • Background técnico prévio (Data Analyst, Data Engineer ou BI Developer).
  • Experiência com cloud (Azure, AWS ou GCP).
  • Uso de soluções de IA como aceleradores de entrega.
  • Conhecimento em SQL para validações básicas.
  • Vivência com change management em contextos data-driven.
  • Conhecimento em governança de dados (ex: DAMA-DMBOK).
  • Certificações (PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, PSM, SAFe ou similares).
  • Experiência com gestão de portfólio e priorização estratégica.

description:

Estamos em busca de um Gerente de Vendas Sênior com experiência relevante na indústria de componentes eletrônicos para integrar a equipe da Win Source. O candidato ideal será responsável por desenvolver contas, realizar o acompanhamento de consultas e manter relacionamentos de longo prazo. Esta posição é fundamental para aprimorar o desempenho de vendas da empresa e a satisfação do cliente.


Sobre a Win Source:


A Win Source é uma distribuidora líder de componentes eletrônicos, comprometida em oferecer serviços de excelência e soluções inovadoras para clientes em todo o mundo. Nossa missão é apoiar o avanço tecnológico de nossos clientes, garantindo a disponibilidade de componentes de alta qualidade.


Site da empresa: win-source.net


Conteúdo do Trabalho: (Jornada de trabalho de 5 dias, 8 horas diárias)

1. Desenvolver clientes, realizar acompanhamento (follow-up), identificar e classificar consultas de clientes, e executar a manutenção contínua desses contatos.

2. Elaborar cotações para produtos solicitados pelos clientes, acompanhar a demanda dos clientes por produtos, conduzir negociações comerciais, concluir pedidos e monitorar a entrega dos produtos para garantir a qualidade, quantidade, prazo de entrega e modalidade de transporte, conforme os requisitos do cliente.

3. Desenvolver estrategicamente seu território de vendas por meio da aquisição planejada e sistemática de novos clientes, mantendo comunicação e coordenação constantes com os departamentos internos de atendimento e técnico.

4. Manter regularmente um bom serviço de pós-venda e bons relacionamentos com os clientes, via e-mail e telefone, preservando parcerias de cooperação de longo prazo.

5. Motivar e liderar a equipe de vendas, definir objetivos claros, monitorar a evolução do desempenho e fornecer os treinamentos e recursos necessários.

6. Realizar viagens de negócios locais para visitar clientes e participar de diversas feiras e exposições do setor.


Perspectivas de Carreira:

Engenheiro de Vendas Sênior → Líder de Equipe Comercial → Gerente Regional → Diretor de Vendas


Sistema Remuneratório:

Salário base + Comissão + Bônus por Desempenho + Bônus por Projetos + Bônus de Final de Ano


Requisitos para a Vaga:

1. Disponibilidade para atuar em escritórios nacionais em diversas partes do mundo.

Os países com vagas abertas incluem: Estados Unidos, Japão, Reino Unido, Canadá, Alemanha, Itália, Austrália, Dinamarca, Espanha, França, Coreia do Sul, Brasil e Malásia. (É exigido residir e trabalhar localmente, além de possuir planos de desenvolvimento de longo prazo na região).

2. Possuir conhecimento específico sobre componentes eletrônicos ou sobre a indústria eletrônica, compreendendo as tendências de mercado e as necessidades dos clientes.

3. Experiência na indústria de distribuição de componentes eletrônicos é um diferencial.


Benefícios:

1. Desfrutar de feriados nacionais oficiais e benefícios festivos. 2. Os funcionários efetivos terão direito a gratificações por tempo de serviço, férias anuais remuneradas (de até 10 dias) e licença-maternidade remunerada.

3. A empresa organiza viagens anualmente e promove outras atividades periodicamente.

4. Convidamos regularmente profissionais de destaque do setor para treinamentos e aprendizado, além de realizarmos sessões de compartilhamento de experiências de negócios.

5. A empresa participa regularmente de feiras internacionais de eletrônicos todos os anos (nos Estados Unidos, Alemanha, Vietnã e Brasil).

6. Oferecemos treinamento remunerado abrangente, incluindo capacitação inicial sobre produtos, métodos comerciais e raciocínio estratégico, organizado em etapas para garantir uma formação sistemática, com orientação individual personalizada (mentoria 1 a 1).

7. O período de experiência inclui o recebimento de comissões, e há dois dias de folga aos finais de semana.


Requisitos e Habilidades:

1. Graduação (nível superior) ou formação acadêmica superior; a área de formação é flexível (preferência para cursos em Engenharia Eletrônica ou Marketing).

2. Boas habilidades de escuta, fala, leitura e escrita; proficiência no uso do idioma inglês para comunicação e negociação com clientes.

3. Boas habilidades de comunicação, coordenação e execução; capacidade de resposta rápida e perspicaz; forte senso de responsabilidade.

4. Experiência em técnicas e estratégias de vendas, incluindo habilidades de apresentação e negociação.

5. Forte capacidade de aprendizado e espírito de busca por aprendizado contínuo.

6. Aspiração em atuar e paixão pelo setor de comércio exterior e e-commerce.

7. Bom espírito de equipe.
